dslRule:
<!id: boolean.value.comparison.true>
<!description: Replace 'boolean == true' with 'boolean' for clarity and brevity.>
<!severity: HINT>
$x == true :: (instanceof($x, "boolean") || instanceof($x, "java.lang.Boolean")) && hasNoSideEffect($x)
=>
$x
;;

<!id: boolean.value.comparison.false>
<!description: Replace 'boolean == false' with '!boolean' for clarity and brevity.>
<!severity: HINT>
$x == false :: (instanceof($x, "boolean") || instanceof($x, "java.lang.Boolean")) && hasNoSideEffect($x)
=>
!$x
;;
